title.en: Describe a shy child without shrinking him.
title.zh: 谈一个害羞的孩子，但不把他说小。

subtitle.en: Practice language that protects a child's dignity while still naming real social and language needs.
subtitle.zh: 练习一种表达：既保护孩子的尊严，也能说清真实的社交和语言需求。

audience: Bay Area parent · preschool family · bilingual home

note.en: Useful for distinguishing shyness from a character flaw and for supporting gradual social confidence.
note.zh: 帮助区分害羞和性格缺陷，并支持孩子逐步建立社交信心。

sources.title: Temperament: What Makes Your Child Tick

note.zh: 适合学习 slow-to-warm-up 这种气质表达。

moment.context: A friend asks why your four-year-old does not talk much in English or join other children right away.
moment.avoid: He is very shy and not social. His English is not good. I am worried something is wrong.
moment.better: He is slow to warm up in new settings, especially in English. At home he is very affectionate, curious, and interactive, so I am trying to support his social confidence without turning it into a negative story about him.

principle.en: Name the support need without making it the child's identity.
principle.zh: 说出需要支持的地方，但不要把它变成孩子的身份。

frames.en: Temperament is not failure. Some children need more time before they feel safe to participate.
frames.zh: 气质不是失败。有些孩子需要更多时间，才会觉得安全并参与。

frames.en: A child's public behavior may not show the whole child; include what you see at home.
frames.zh: 孩子在外面的表现不等于整个孩子；要补充你在家里看到的部分。

frames.en: Use strengths plus needs: affectionate at home, observant in groups, needs gentle entry into peer play.
frames.zh: 用优点加需求：在家亲密、在群体中观察、需要温和进入同伴游戏。

frames.en: Do not apologize for your child as if he is a problem to be managed.
frames.zh: 不要像替问题道歉一样替孩子道歉。

phraseBank.line: He is slow to warm up, but once he feels safe, he is very connected and playful.

why.en: It names the shy behavior while giving the listener a fuller picture.
why.zh: 它说出害羞表现，同时给听者一个更完整的孩子形象。

phraseBank.line: In a new group, he may watch before joining. If you give him a small role, he usually enters more comfortably.

why.en: It turns observation into a practical support strategy.
why.zh: 把观察变成可执行支持方式。

phraseBank.line: His quietness is information, not a verdict.

why.en: It calms the parent's anxiety without ignoring the pattern.
why.zh: 安抚父母焦虑，但不忽略模式。

meaning.en: Needing time to feel comfortable before engaging.
meaning.zh: 需要时间感到舒服后才参与。

use.en: Slow to warm up sounds more neutral and respectful than bad at socializing.
use.zh: Slow to warm up 比 bad at socializing 更中性、更尊重。

meaning.en: Careful at watching and noticing what is happening.
meaning.zh: 善于观察、留意正在发生什么。

use.en: He is observant in groups before he joins.
use.zh: 他在加入群体前会先观察。

meaning.en: A child's growing comfort in being with other people.
meaning.zh: 孩子和他人在一起时逐渐增长的舒适感。

use.en: We are helping him build social confidence gradually.
use.zh: 我们在帮他逐步建立社交信心。

meaning.en: A low-pressure way to join a new activity or group.
meaning.zh: 低压力进入新活动或群体的方式。

use.en: He does better with gentle entry than with sudden pressure to perform.
use.zh: 相比突然被要求表现，他更适合温和进入。

scripts.line: He may watch for a bit before joining. He is taking it in, and I will help him find a comfortable way in.

why.en: It prevents other adults from misreading quietness as rejection.
why.zh: 避免其他成人把安静误读为拒绝。

scripts.line: Could we notice what helps him join? I am not looking for pressure; I am looking for a gentle bridge.

why.en: It asks for collaboration without demanding a special label.
why.zh: 请求协作，但不急着要特殊标签。

scripts.line: I do not want us to call him antisocial. He connects beautifully at home; he just needs more time in new spaces.

why.en: It protects the child's identity inside the family narrative.
why.zh: 保护孩子在家庭叙事里的身份。

reflection.en: When you describe a child, include both the challenge and the child behind the challenge.
reflection.zh: 描述孩子时，要同时包含挑战和挑战背后的孩子。

reflection.en: The goal is not to make shyness disappear; the goal is to help the child feel safe enough to grow.
reflection.zh: 目标不是让害羞消失，而是让孩子安全到可以成长。

reflection.en: A parent can be honest without making the child sound broken.
reflection.zh: 父母可以诚实，同时不把孩子说成坏掉了。
